name_zh: 不丹·扎布德隆：统一与宗堡佛教法王
name_en: Bhutan Zhabdrung: Unification & Dzong Buddhism Dharma King
description_zh: 扎布德隆·纳姆耶尔 (1594-1651) 不丹统一者，建立宗堡(堡垒寺院)双重政教体系，确立噶举派佛教国教，抵抗西藏/蒙古入侵，奠定不丹独特政教合一国家认同。
description_en: Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal (1594-1651) Bhutan unifier, established Dzong (fortress-monastery) dual secular-religious system, established Kagyu Buddhism state religion, resisted Tibetan/Mongol invasions, founded Bhutan unique theocratic national identity.
reason_zh: 扎布德隆代表喜马拉雅佛教政教合一国家建构典范，展示了宗堡系统如何同时作为军事防御、行政中心、宗教修行场所，其双重体系延续至今定义不丹国家性质。
reason_en: Zhabdrung represents Himalayan Buddhist theocratic state construction paradigm, demonstrating how Dzong system simultaneously serves military defense, administrative center, religious practice site, its dual system enduring today defining Bhutan state nature.
steps_zh: 研究扎布德隆早年西藏贵族与噶举派传承
分析1616年入不丹建立宗堡网络与双重体系
探讨抵抗西藏噶厦政府与蒙古固始汗入侵
评估噶举派佛教国教与转世继承制度确立
总结扎布德隆统一宗堡佛教法王对不丹国家认同的四百年奠基
steps_en: Study Zhabdrung early Tibetan nobility and Kagyu lineage transmission
Analyze 1616 entry Bhutan establishing Dzong network and dual system
Explore resisting Tibetan Ganden Phodrang and Mongol Gushri Khan invasions
Evaluate Kagyu Buddhism state religion and reincarnation succession system establishment
Summarize Zhabdrung unification Dzong Buddhism dharma king four-century foundation for Bhutan national identity
expected_zh: 理解政教合一如何在喜马拉雅小国构建持久国家认同，掌握宗堡双重体系军事行政宗教三位一体逻辑，评估扎布德隆遗产对现代不丹GNH与民主化的文化基因贡献。
expected_en: Understand how theocracy builds enduring national identity in Himalayan small state, grasp Dzong dual system military-administrative-religious trinity logic, evaluate Zhabdrung legacy cultural gene contribution for modern Bhutan GNH and democratization.
case_zh: 1594 出生；1616 入不丹；1651 圆寂。扎布德隆统一宗堡佛教法王范式永存。
case_en: 1594 birth; 1616 entered Bhutan; 1651 parinirvana. Zhabdrung unification Dzong Buddhism dharma king paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Bhutan unification; Dzong system; Kagyu Buddhism; theocratic statecraft
